TABER Rotary Platform Abraser Model 5135 / 5155 from Taber Industries 
View Supplier Profile
Request Quote 
This video shows the functioning of Taber Industries’ TABER Rotary Platform Abraser Model 5135 / 5155. This easy-to-operate, precision-built instrument has capacity to provide reliable data in a matter of minutes. It features speed control options of 60 and 72rpm, vacuum system with precision height adjustment and sealed aluminum housing. 
The TABER Abraser is primarily used in the testing of plastics, ceramics, textiles, leather, metals, rubber and painted, lacquered and electroplated surfaces.
